title: Canopy traits across tropical forests mapped with deep learning and satellite data
summary: Field data from more than 1,800 vegetation plots, combined with satellite, terrain, climate and soil data and convolutional neural networks, predicted variation in 13 tree functional traits. Tropical American forests show about 40% greater functional richness than African and Asian forests, and African forests show 32% higher functional divergence than American forests. The authors caution that accuracy depends on data quality and coverage, and that AI should support rather than replace field sampling.
ai_technology: Convolutional neural networks combined with satellite spectral data

evidence.tested: Trait predictions from field data on more than 1,800 vegetation plots, combined with satellite, terrain, climate and soil data, were checked with an uncertainty analysis.
evidence.unknown: Accuracy depends on data quality and coverage, and further data collection would refine the maps.
